description: The file defines a partial class 'SetExam1' for an ASP.NET web page, handling navigation between different pages via button click events. It facilitates the setup of an online examination system by transferring to various pages such as admin panel, leaderboard, and question set pages.

classes.name: SetExam1
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind for the SetExam.aspx web page, responsible for handling button events and navigation within the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the home button; transfers to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the profile button click; currently no action specified.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the leaderboard button click; transfers to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: theoryB_Click
methods.description: Handles the theory question set button click; transfers to TheorySet.aspx.

methods.name: mcqB_Click
methods.description: Handles the multiple-choice question set button click; transfers to MCQSet.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the logout button click; transfers to LoginPage.aspx.
